ru.title: Защита аудио-языковых моделей от неслышимых атак через переобучение и детектирование сдвигов
ru.desc: Исследователи предложили метод красного тестирования (red-teaming) для выявления уязвимостей в аудио-языковых моделях с помощью неслышимых низкочастотных сигналов. Они разработали алгоритм ILL, который использует универсальный шаблон волны в чёрном ящике, применяя оценку масштаба внимания предложений и передачу спектральной путаницы для создания атак. Для защиты предложена система DRG, которая обнаруживает сдвиги в распределении данных и запрашивает повторную запись аудио для восстановления точности модели. Результаты показали, что атаки снижают точность на 67 процентных пункта, при этом сохраняя полную неслышимость для человека.

en.title: Uncovering Hidden Risks in Audio-Language Models
en.desc: This paper introduces a method called Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout (ILL) to test the vulnerabilities of large audio-language models (LALMs) using inaudible low-frequency sounds. The researchers found that these low-frequency inputs can significantly affect the model's performance, reducing accuracy by up to 67%. To counter this risk, they developed a defense mechanism called Distributional Requery Guard (DRG), which detects changes in audio input distribution and prompts for a second recording to improve accuracy. This work highlights a critical safety concern in LALMs and sets the stage for further exploration into making audio understanding more robust.

zh.title: 揭示音频语言模型的隐秘脆弱性
zh.desc: 本研究提出了一种黑箱红队方法，利用人耳无法听到的低频波形来揭示音频语言模型的脆弱性。我们引入了间歇性低频锁定（ILL）方法，通过通用波形模板在黑箱环境中评估低频输入的风险。为了应对这一风险，我们提出了分布重询问保护（DRG），能够检测低频分布变化并请求第二次录音以恢复语义准确性。实验结果表明，ILL在六个音频语言模型上显著降低了准确率，同时DRG提高了被攻击后的准确率，揭示了音频语言模型的安全隐患。

papers.title: TailBooster: A Dual-Layer Generative Framework for Extreme Value Augmentation with Operational Validity Enforcement
papers.abstract: Abstract TailBooster uses a dual-layer generative framework with statistical tail extraction and deep autoencoder cleaning to synthesize operationally valid extreme air-transport events, substantially improving extreme-event prediction accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Extreme events in air transport, such as severe arrival delays and abnormal air times, cause cascading network disruptions with substantial operational, economic, and safety costs. Such events are rare in historical records, leaving insufficient training signal for machine learning models. Synthetic data augmentation offers a principled solution, but conventional generative models under-represent distributional tails and give no guarantee against operationally infeasible instances, such as a short air time paired with a long flight distance. No existing approach addresses both limitations for mixed-type tabular records. We propose TailBooster, a dual-layer generative framework combining generative modelling with two anomaly detection layers. A statistical layer extracts extremes via the interquartile range, supplying tail-concentrated training signal to dedicated generative models, here a Tabular Variational Autoencoder. A deep learning layer then applies autoencoder-based cleaning, discarding synthetic records that violate the operational envelope learned from historical data. The framework was evaluated on US flight records across five dimensions: diversity, statistical similarity, fidelity, operational validity, and utility, the latter two being the primary improvement targets. Data-driven cleaning markedly improved operational validity, while targeted augmentation enhanced utility for extreme-event prediction. Across six regression algorithms, training on the framework's records reduced Mean Absolute Error by 47-49% on extreme air time and 29-57% on extreme arrival delay prediction relative to conventional synthetic data, with comparable gains when real records were enriched with synthetic extremes. Being fully data-driven and model-agnostic, TailBooster extends to domains where extreme-event prediction is critical and domain-specific rules are unavailable.
affiliations: Faculty of Aerospace Engineering, Delft University of Technology (TU Delft), Kluyverweg 1, Delft, 2629 HS, South Holland, Netherlands

ru.title: Синтез экстремальных событий для прогнозирования редких явлений в авиации
ru.desc: TailBooster предлагает двухуровневый генеративный фреймворк для синтеза редких экстремальных событий в авиатранспорте, которые недостаточно представлены в исторических данных. Первый уровень использует статистическое извлечение хвостов распределения и Tabular Variational Autoencoder для генерации синтетических данных, сконцентрированных на экстремальных значениях. Второй уровень применяет фильтрацию на основе автоэнкодера, исключая операционально невалидные примеры, которые нарушают физические и логические ограничения. Экспериментальные результаты показывают значительное улучшение точности предсказания экстремальных задержек и времени полета на 29-57% по сравнению с обычными методами augmentation данных.

en.title: Boosting Predictions of Extreme Air Events with TailBooster
en.desc: TailBooster is a novel dual-layer generative framework designed to improve the prediction of extreme air-transport events, such as severe delays. It addresses the challenge of rare events in historical data by synthesizing operationally valid scenarios using a combination of statistical tail extraction and deep autoencoder cleaning. The framework enhances the training signal for machine learning models by focusing on the distributional tails of data, ensuring that generated instances are operationally feasible. Evaluation results show significant reductions in prediction errors for extreme events, demonstrating TailBooster's effectiveness in various operational contexts.

zh.title: TailBooster：提升极端事件预测的双层生成框架
zh.desc: TailBooster 是一种双层生成框架，结合了统计尾部提取和深度自编码器清理，旨在合成有效的极端航空运输事件，从而显著提高极端事件预测的准确性。由于极端事件在历史记录中较为稀少，传统的机器学习模型缺乏足够的训练信号。TailBooster 通过统计层提取极端值，并利用自编码器清理不符合操作规范的合成记录，确保生成的数据在实际操作中有效。该框架在美国航班记录上进行了评估，显示出在操作有效性和实用性方面的显著提升。

papers.title: PixSDS: Why Latent SDS Makes Noisy Pixels
papers.abstract: Abstract PixSDS fixes VAE-induced pixel drift in latent score distillation sampling by guiding optimization with decoded image directions, reducing artifacts in text-to-3D generation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) enables text-to-3D generation by optimizing rendered images with a pretrained diffusion prior, but latent SDS often produces structured color artifacts and high-frequency texture noise. We identify a failure mode of latent SDS caused by VAE-induced pixel drift: the optimized image can move along pixel-space directions that are weakly constrained by the VAE encoder, so its latent representation remains clean and semantically meaningful while the image itself accumulates visible artifacts. We support this diagnosis with controlled 2D SDS experiments, VAE-only optimization, and a simplified analysis showing that encoder-like latent objectives can amplify image-space noise when the inverse mapping to pixels is underconstrained. Motivated by this observation, we propose PixSDS, a lightweight VAE-consistent gradient repair method. PixSDS decodes a latent SDS lookahead step and uses the decoded image as a clean direction for pixel-space optimization, reducing motion in VAE-inconsistent directions without retraining the diffusion model, changing the renderer, or replacing the SDS objective. Experiments in 2D optimization and text-to-3D generation show that PixSDS substantially reduces structured artifacts while preserving semantic content. Code is publicly available at https://sevashasla.github.io/pixsds-webpage/.

ru.title: PixSDS: исправление дрейфа пикселей в латентной оптимизации для синтеза 3D
ru.desc: В статье исследуется проблема VAE-индуцированного дрейфа пикселей при использовании latent score distillation sampling (SDS) для генерации 3D-моделей по текстовому описанию. Авторы обнаруживают, что оптимизируемое изображение может смещаться вдоль направлений в пространстве пикселей, которые слабо ограничены энкодером VAE, что приводит к накоплению визуальных артефактов при сохранении чистого латентного представления. Они предлагают PixSDS — лёгкий метод коррекции градиентов, согласованный с VAE, который декодирует предварительный шаг и использует декодированное изображение как чистое направление для оптимизации в пространстве пикселей. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что PixSDS значительно уменьшает структурированные артефакты, сохраняя семантическое содержание изображения.

en.title: PixSDS: Clean Image Generation with Guided Optimization
en.desc: The paper introduces PixSDS, a method designed to address pixel drift issues caused by Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) in latent score distillation sampling (SDS) for text-to-3D generation. It identifies that the pixel drift leads to visible artifacts in generated images, as the optimization process can move in directions that are not well-constrained by the VAE encoder. To mitigate this, PixSDS employs a technique that decodes a lookahead step from the latent space and uses this decoded image to guide pixel-space optimization, ensuring that the generated images remain clean and semantically coherent. Experimental results demonstrate that PixSDS effectively reduces artifacts while maintaining the integrity of the generated content without the need for retraining the diffusion model or altering the existing rendering process.

zh.title: PixSDS：减少文本到3D生成中的伪影
zh.desc: PixSDS是一种修复变分自编码器（VAE）引起的像素漂移的方法，旨在通过解码图像方向来指导优化，从而减少文本到3D生成中的伪影。该方法通过优化渲染图像与预训练的扩散先验相结合，解决了潜在的分数蒸馏采样（SDS）中常见的结构化颜色伪影和高频纹理噪声问题。研究表明，VAE引起的像素漂移会导致优化图像在像素空间中沿着弱约束的方向移动，从而使图像积累可见的伪影。PixSDS通过解码潜在SDS的前瞻步骤，使用解码后的图像作为干净的优化方向，有效减少了VAE不一致方向的运动，同时保持了语义内容。

papers.title: CW-BASS v2: Saturation-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection for Semi-Supervised Segmentation under Foundation-Model Teachers
papers.abstract: Abstract CW-BASS v2 selects pseudo-labels by measuring teacher reliability on held-out data and applying either strict filtering or an adaptive floor to avoid confirmation bias under saturated confidence.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Semi-supervised semantic segmentation has long turned on one question, which pseudo-labels to trust, and a generation of selection rules, dynamic thresholds, per-class curricula, soft confidence weights, answered it for the noisy, under-confident ResNet teachers of their day. Self-supervised foundation encoders change the regime: with a DINOv2 teacher, confidence saturates, so the filtering that helped a weak teacher can hurt a strong one. We propose CW-BASS v2, a saturation-aware pseudo-label selection method that reads the teacher's confidence regime rather than committing to one rule. It pairs held-out calibration, an unbiased per-class noise estimate, with a self-adaptive confidence floor that provably bounds retention away from 1, and combines them in a one-pass gate: measure the reliability of the teacher's confident set, pi_kept = Pr[correct | c >= tau], on a held-out slice, and filter strictly when it meets the confidence demanded (pi_kept >= tau), falling back to the adaptive floor otherwise. The boundary is the pre-existing operating threshold, not a value tuned to mIoU, and across six DINOv2 teachers it makes the correct strict-vs-floor call blind. CW-BASS v2 thus recovers the UniMatch V2 operating point on the saturated benchmarks by selecting strict (Pascal VOC 1/8 87.4 against its reported 87.9; Cityscapes within 0.5), and improves on it where the confident set is unreliable (pi_kept ~ 89%, ADE20K), where the floor edges ahead (+1.5 mIoU, single seed). The gate is principled because the failure it avoids is measured, not assumed: on a reliable, saturated teacher the confidence distribution's dynamic range collapses (98% of Pascal pixels >= 0.95), so an adaptive cutoff floods the retention mask and self-training decays into confirmation bias.
affiliations: AI Research Department, Ebenworks Systems, Seoul, Korea

ru.title: Адаптивный выбор псевдо-меток для насыщенных учителей
ru.desc: CW-BASS v2 — это метод выбора псевдо-меток для полу-контролируемой семантической сегментации, который адаптируется к режиму уверенности учителя-модели. Авторы предлагают использовать калибровку на held-out данных для оценки надёжности предсказаний и применять либо строгую фильтрацию, либо адаптивный порог в зависимости от поведения модели. Метод решает проблему насыщения уверенности современных фундаментальных моделей вроде DINOv2, когда традиционные пороги отсеивания становятся неэффективны и приводят к смещению подтверждения. Экспериментально показано, что CW-BASS v2 автоматически выбирает правильную стратегию фильтрации и достигает конкурентных результатов на бенчмарках Pascal VOC, Cityscapes и ADE20K.

en.title: Smart Label Selection for Strong Teachers
en.desc: The paper presents CW-BASS v2, a method for selecting pseudo-labels in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by assessing the reliability of teacher models on held-out data. It addresses the challenge of confirmation bias that arises when using strong teachers with saturated confidence levels. By implementing a saturation-aware approach, CW-BASS v2 combines held-out calibration and an adaptive confidence floor to effectively filter pseudo-labels. This method improves performance on benchmarks by making informed decisions about which labels to trust, thus enhancing the training process.

zh.title: 动态选择伪标签，提升模型可靠性
zh.desc: CW-BASS v2 是一种选择伪标签的方法，它通过测量教师在保留数据上的可靠性来避免确认偏差。该方法采用严格过滤或自适应阈值，以应对教师信心饱和的问题。与传统的弱教师不同，CW-BASS v2 能够根据教师的信心状态动态调整选择规则，从而提高伪标签的质量。通过这种方式，CW-BASS v2 在多个基准测试中表现出色，能够有效地选择可靠的伪标签。

papers.title: RibAssist 3D: Biplanar Rib-Fracture Detection, Addressing, and Selective 3D Localization from CT-Derived Projections
papers.abstract: Abstract Cross-view pairing of rib fractures in orthogonal CT projections enables accurate 3D localization, but correspondence confidence remains the primary bottleneck.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Rib fractures are common and time-consuming to localize on computed tomography (CT). We ask whether fractures detected independently in two orthogonal CT-derived projections (anteroposterior and lateral) can be paired across views and triangulated into reliable 3D points at a controlled rate of false outputs, and we answer it with a staged diagnostic study. The projection geometry is exact, and given correct correspondence, localization is accurate (median 4.0 mm, 88% within 10 mm, 93.6% rib-exact). On a sealed 55-case cohort, a large share of fractures is in principle recoverable (61.1% dual-view availability, and a correct pair present in the candidate graph for 58.4% of fractures), yet the binding limitation is neither geometry nor localization but confidence-limited cross-view correspondence. A controlled detector-by-correspondence factorial attributes the operational gain to lateral-detector quality rather than the tested matching methods; retraining the lateral detector produces the first nonzero controlled-budget reconstructions. Under a deliberately conservative commitment policy, a pre-specified sealed pass promotes 15 of 601 fractures to correct 3D localizations at 0.436 false points per case (2.50% end-to-end commitment yield), and committed points are accurate (median 1.49 mm, 93% rib-exact). The low yield is a consequence of confidence-gated abstention, not of geometry or detection: the study establishes a reproducible framework for selective 3D localization and identifies cross-view correspondence as the dominant operational bottleneck.
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

ru.title: Сопоставление проекций как ключ к надёжной 3D-локализации переломов рёбер
ru.desc: В работе предлагается метод для точной трёхмерной локализации переломов рёбер на КТ-снимках путём сопоставления переломов, обнаруженных независимо на двух ортогональных проекциях (передне-задней и боковой). Авторы используют геометрию проекций и триангуляцию для восстановления 3D-координат переломов, достигая медианной точности 4,0 мм при достаточной уверенности в соответствии. Основным узким местом оказалось не геометрическое разрешение и не качество обнаружения, а задача установления надёжного соответствия между переломами на разных проекциях. Исследование показало, что при консервативной политике отбора удаётся с высокой точностью локализовать лишь небольшую долю переломов, но это ограничение связано с пороговой уверенностью, а не с фундаментальными геометрическими препятствиями.

en.title: Enhancing 3D Rib Fracture Localization through Cross-View Correspondence
en.desc: This paper discusses a method for accurately localizing rib fractures in 3D using two orthogonal CT projections. The authors investigate whether fractures detected in separate views can be paired and triangulated to improve localization accuracy. They find that the main challenge is not the geometry or detection of fractures, but rather the confidence in matching fractures across views. The study establishes a framework for selective 3D localization and highlights the importance of improving cross-view correspondence to enhance operational efficiency.

zh.title: 交叉视图配对：肋骨骨折的精准三维定位
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了如何通过正交CT投影对肋骨骨折进行交叉视图配对，以实现准确的三维定位。尽管投影几何是精确的，但主要瓶颈在于配对的置信度。研究表明，独立检测到的肋骨骨折在两个视图中可以有效配对，并通过三角测量得到可靠的三维点。最终，研究建立了一个可重复的框架，用于选择性三维定位，并确认交叉视图配对是主要的操作瓶颈。

papers.title: Mitigating Gender Bias in English to Romanian Machine Translation
papers.abstract: Abstract A hybrid pipeline combining LLM gender classification with tag-aware neural translation improves gender accuracy in English-to-Romanian machine translation.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Machine translation (MT) systems often fail to correctly translate gender, especially when converting from a gender-neutral language like English to a gendered target language such as Romanian. This bias results in translations that default to masculine forms or reinforce gender stereotypes. We propose a hybrid pipeline to mitigate this issue by combining large language model (LLM)-based gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT). Our system uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect the intended gender of target words in English sentences and insert inline gender hint tags. These tagged sentences are then passed to a Transformer model fine-tuned to generate morphologically correct Romanian translations. To support this, we introduce three novel datasets for gender disambiguation and translation. Our approach improves gender accuracy on the WinoMT and WinoGender benchmarks by over 40 percentage points compared to a baseline MT system. This is the first method to explicitly address and evaluate gender bias in English-Romanian MT using both LLM inference and tag-aware translation.
affiliations: Human Language Technologies Research Center, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Bucharest

ru.title: Преодоление гендерной предвзятости в машинном переводе через LLM-классификацию и размеченный нейронный перевод
ru.desc: Статья описывает гибридный подход к решению проблемы гендерной предвзятости в машинном переводе с английского на румынский язык. Авторы используют fine-tuned большую языковую модель для классификации гендера целевых слов и вставки специальных тегов в исходные предложения. Затем размеченные предложения обрабатываются Transformer моделью, которая генерирует морфологически корректные румынские переводы с правильным гендером. Предложенный метод достигает улучшения точности гендерного перевода более чем на 40 процентных пункта по сравнению с базовой системой машинного перевода.

en.title: Enhancing Gender Accuracy in English-Romanian Translation
en.desc: This paper presents a new method to improve gender accuracy in machine translation from English to Romanian. It combines large language model (LLM) gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT) to address the common issue of gender bias in translations. The system identifies the intended gender in English sentences and uses gender hint tags to guide the translation process. By fine-tuning a Transformer model with these tags, the approach significantly enhances translation accuracy, achieving over 40 percentage points improvement on established benchmarks.

zh.title: 提升机器翻译中的性别准确性
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种混合管道，结合了大型语言模型（LLM）性别分类和标签感知神经翻译，以提高英语到罗马尼亚语机器翻译中的性别准确性。传统的机器翻译系统在将性别中立的英语翻译成性别明确的罗马尼亚语时，常常会出现性别翻译错误，导致默认使用男性形式或强化性别刻板印象。我们的方法通过使用微调的LLM来检测英语句子中目标词的性别，并插入性别提示标签，从而改善翻译结果。我们的系统在WinoMT和WinoGender基准测试中，相比于基线机器翻译系统，性别准确性提高了超过40个百分点。
